Make the project tree communicate architecture

Project-structure diagnostics place each recognised element in the folder that represents its role. A developer can inspect the source tree and understand the system's layers before reading implementation details.

The value of enforcing this family

Correct placement also makes dependency mistakes and missing architectural boundaries easier to spot during review.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
